title: Gate Every Hand-Off
description: An AI agent is strong inside a stage and weak at the seams between them. The fix is a deterministic gate on every hand-off — a non-AI check the agent can't talk its way past. The shape, and the day production published fiction.
cardDesc: Agents work inside a stage; deterministic gates verify between. Gate the seam, not the middle.
principles: Keep agents inside stages and deterministic gates between them.
Derive the stage from disk instead of trusting the claim.
Do not mistake a second agent for a gate.
